profile_candidate.scope: Local RAG/dashboard privacy, host guards and routed-work contracts using test data; no access to real vaults or model evaluation.

access-boundary.claim: Local service host guards reject access through an untrusted host.

data-exposure.claim: Configuration and package checks avoid including private vault paths or overlays.

untrusted-instructions.claim: Retrieved context has no implied write authority; behavior evaluation remains a separate required gap.

consequential-actions.claim: Work-item review transitions are constrained by the dashboard contract.

evidence-lineage.claim: Freshness and indexing tests keep retrieval provenance explicit.

bounded-claims.claim: Offline unit results do not claim real vault integrity or model-grounding accuracy.
